tapeLine: Wednesday 28 October closed higher after the Fed held: S&P 500 +0.28% to 7,743.98, Nasdaq +0.27% to 26,549.85, Dow +0.19% (97.53 points) to 52,475.10, per search-indexed coverage of the 28 Oct close (CNBC, Xinhua, Bloomberg). Thursday futures levels were not confirmed.
matters:
The Fed left its target range at 3.75%–4.00% on Wednesday 28 October. The vote was 10–2, with Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissenting in favor of a quarter-point hike, per CNN and Admiral Markets coverage (28 Oct). Bloomberg described the Fed as giving no clear signal on a December hike; one source put the priced odds of a December 25 bp hike near 85%, which is a single unverified figure.

A Stock Titan headline (28 Oct) says Fortinet and Alphabet fell after hours. Microsoft’s reaction and the size of the moves were not found, so they are not carried. Amazon is due later this week.

The S&P 500 is about 0.9% under its 7,811.54 record close of 9 October, per the prior brief.
